notes: Free-first strategy: open official airline booking flow and manually search 9 adults.
Do not automate login-only portals or scrape airline booking flows without permission.
Deep links are intentionally conservative; most airline sites use dynamic booking widgets.

DY.name: Norwegian
DY.instructions: Open Norwegian booking, choose one-way if checking one leg, enter route/date, set 9 adults, and see whether the flight can be selected/priced.

D8.name: Norwegian Air Sweden
D8.instructions: Use Norwegian booking for D8/Norwegian Air Sweden marketed flights. Search 9 adults and record whether the specific flight appears.

WF.name: Wideroe
WF.instructions: Open Wideroe booking, enter route/date, set adults as high as supported up to 9, and record the result. If the site caps below 9, mark 'some' and note the cap.

EK.name: Emirates
EK.instructions: Emirates booking supports up to 9 passengers. Search 9 adults for the leg/date and record whether the flight can be selected/priced.

QR.name: Qatar Airways
QR.instructions: Open Qatar Airways booking, enter route/date, set 9 adults if supported, and record whether the flight can be selected/priced.
